propositions: The typecheck make target currently runs mypy only over src/rebar but not scripts/, leaving 47 scripts/ files lint-clean but type-unchecked despite being invoked by CI gating steps.

Widening mypy scope to include scripts/ surfaces 15 type errors across 6 files (check_raw_git_writes.py, plan_review_impact_distribution.py, capture_jira_fixtures.py, probe_rebar.py, check_complexity_baseline.py, t5c_calibrate.py), including two latent bugs (strip() on str|None and guard placement for dict|None).
The sys.path bootstrap pattern in scripts/ is already accommodated by pyproject.toml follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports=true, so no structural changes needed.
Stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml must be updated to reflect that typecheck now covers src/rebar and scripts/.
A guard test (test_typecheck_scope.py) must verify scripts/ remains in the typecheck recipe and reject regressions to mypy src/rebar only.
